args.command: echo '=== TUI PROCESSES ==='; ps -u zenui -o pid,ppid,comm,%cpu,%mem,rss,vsz,args --sort=-%cpu | grep -E 'zen-living-tui|xterm' || true; echo '=== LEGACY CHROME VISUALIZER ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lx 2>/dev/null | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /google-chrome/ && tolower($0) ~ /zen living system/ {print}' || true; echo '=== WEB VISUALIZER SERVICE ==='; systemctl is-active zen-living-visualizer.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== WINDOWS ==='; runuser -u zenui -- env DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lxG 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Read-only verify Living TUI resource footprint and confirm legacy web visualizer is retired
